description: This Go source file defines functions for parsing target strings in gRPC connections, specifically handling different schemes like unix sockets, IP addresses, and host:port formats. It includes functions to parse and validate target strings, extract host and port information, and handle special cases like IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: ParseCanonicalTarget
methods.description: Parses a target string into host and port components, handling different schemes and formats.

methods.name: parseUnix
methods.description: Parses unix socket target strings, returning the socket path.

methods.name: parseEndpoint
methods.description: Parses general endpoint strings, extracting host and port information.

methods.name: parseIP
methods.description: Attempts to parse an endpoint as an IP address, returning normalized IP string if successful.
